```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
var __cjs = (factory, module) => function __require() {
	if (module === undefined) {
		module = { exports: {} };
		factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports);
	}
	return module.exports;
};
var require_no_side_effects = /*#__PURE__*/ __cjs(function(module, exports) {

/*!*********************************!*\
  !*** ./foo/no-side-effects.cjs ***!
  \*********************************/
console.log("cjs");

});

// NAMESPACE OBJECT: ./foo/no-side-effects.js
var no_side_effects_namespaceObject = {};
__webpack_require__.r(no_side_effects_namespaceObject);


// NAMESPACE OBJECT: ./foo/no-side-effects.mjs
var foo_no_side_effects_namespaceObject = {};
__webpack_require__.r(foo_no_side_effects_namespaceObject);


// ./foo/no-side-effects.js
console.log("js");

// ./foo/no-side-effects.mjs
console.log("mjs");

// ./index.js
const no_side_effects_0 = require_no_side_effects();




it("should render missing namespace properties as undefined for side-effect-free modules", () => {
  expect(no_side_effects_namespaceObject.nope).toBeUndefined();
  expect(foo_no_side_effects_namespaceObject.nope).toBeUndefined();
  expect(no_side_effects_0.nope).toBeUndefined();
});

export {};
```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/make_namespace_object
(() => {
// define __esModule on exports
__webpack_require__.r = (exports) => {
	if(typeof Symbol !== 'undefined' && Symbol.toStringTag) {
		Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: 'Module' });
	}
	Object.defineProperty(exports, '__esModule', { value: true });
};
})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
